properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] VMs for DNS: No Public IP Address
properties.description: Denies association of public IP addresses with DNS VM network interfaces. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7). DNS VMs are internal infrastructure components that must only be accessible via private network paths. Administrative access is provided exclusively through Azure Bastion — public IP addresses on DNS VMs are prohibited.

metadata.description: Deny: Block public IP association on VM NICs. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
